mapper.select: select id, registration_id as registrationId, division_id as divisionId, season_id as seasonId, team_id as teamId, change_status as changeStatus, base_lineup_version as baseLineupVersion, submit_member_id as submitMemberId, audit_user_id as auditUserId, audit_remark as auditRemark, audit_time as auditTime, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime, is_delete as isDelete from basket_registration_roster_change where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0

select c.id, c.registration_id as registrationId, c.division_id as divisionId, c.team_id as teamId, t.team_name as teamName, c.change_status as changeStatus, c.base_lineup_version as baseLineupVersion, r.lineup_version as currentLineupVersion, c.create_time as createTime, c.audit_remark as auditRemark from basket_registration_roster_change c inner join basket_registration r on r.id = c.registration_id and r.is_delete = 0 left join basket_team t on t.id = c.team_id and t.is_delete = 0 where c.is_delete = 0 and c.change_status = 'PENDING' and c.division_id = #{divisionId} order by c.id desc

select id, change_id as changeId, player_id as playerId, is_captain as isCaptain, is_starter as isStarter, sort_order as sortOrder, create_time as createTime, is_delete as isDelete from basket_registration_roster_change_player where change_id = #{changeId} and is_delete = 0 order by sort_order, id
mapper.update: update basket_registration_roster_change set change_status = 'APPROVED', audit_user_id = #{auditUserId}, audit_time = #{auditTime}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0 and change_status = 'PENDING'

update basket_registration_roster_change set change_status = 'REJECTED', audit_user_id = #{auditUserId}, audit_remark = #{auditRemark}, audit_time = #{auditTime}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0 and change_status = 'PENDING'
